segments.narration: New Zealand politician Fred Hackett built a remarkable career representing Grey Lynn and serving in cabinet, working tirelessly for his constituents.
The surrounding metal frame and instrument panel showed zero scorching or heat damage. The cabin air was crisp and normal.
Investigators found his leather flight jacket completely intact despite the severe burns on his body. How does a man burn alive while his clothes remain untouched?
Chemical analysis later revealed trace amounts of white phosphorus on his flight suit. The deadly chemical reacts violently with oxygen the second it touches air.
A ruptured flare cartridge inside his emergency kit had ignited spontaneously under high cabin pressure. The mystery solved: an accidental self-contained chemical reaction.
